verdict.rationale: Atlas documents equity paperwork only for founders: it issues founder equity with customizable vesting, files 83(b) elections, and gives access to Cooley-developed legal documents and templates. Nothing in the pack shows the hiring-side paperwork this story asks about. Missing for 10: offer letter generation, employee confidentiality/IP assignment agreements, employee stock option grants or plan administration, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of hiring paperwork workflows.
